description: Audita conformidade com framework AI governance (8 frameworks: JAPAN, HIROSHIMA-ICOC, EU-AIA, KOREA, CAIDP-UG, UNESCO-RAM, MGF-AGENTIC, AI-GOVERNANCE-STACK). Diferente de check_compliance (privacy), foca em obrigações AI: CAIO appointment (DS-920), red teaming evidence (AISI Red Teaming v1.10), data quality docs (AIST ML Quality v3 + AISI Data Quality v1.01), Hiroshima ICOC alignment (11 princípios), AI Business Operator Guidelines compliance (10 princípios METI+MIC). Retorna scored checklist + recommendations + recommendedTool sugerindo submit_hiroshima_icoc_attestation se score≥0.7. AI-GOVERNANCE-STACK é methodology (não regulação) — retorna output descritivo sem scoring. Para per-agent capability-shaped audit, use assess_agent_capability.

jurisdiction.description: Framework alvo. JAPAN = AI Promotion Act 2025 + AIBOG + DS-920 + AISI/AIST. HIROSHIMA-ICOC = G7 international code (66 países). EU-AIA = full content. KOREA = full content. CAIDP-UG = Universal Guidelines + AI Index. UNESCO-RAM = 6 RAM dimensions. MGF-AGENTIC = Singapore IMDA agentic AI framework (2026-01-22). AI-GOVERNANCE-STACK = Kenney L1-L5 methodology (descriptive only, no scoring).
